name: The Ordinary Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1%, Smoothing Serum for Blemish-Prone Skin
description:
A high-strength vitamin and mineral formula designed to visibly reduce the appearance of blemishes, balance sebum activity, and improve skin clarity. This lightweight serum is ideal for oily, congested, or breakout-prone skin.

Key Benefits:

· ✔️ Reduces the appearance of blemishes and breakouts

· ✔️ Controls excess oil and shine

· ✔️ Minimizes enlarged pores

· ✔️ Brightens and evens out skin tone

· ✔️ Strengthens the skin barrier

Key Ingredients:

· Niacinamide (Vitamin B3): Brightens skin tone, reduces blemishes, and strengthens the skin barrier

· Zinc PCA: Helps to balance oil production and reduce inflammation

Active Ingredients:

· Niacinamide 10%

· Zinc 1%

How to Use:

Apply a few drops to the entire face in the morning and evening before heavier creams. Do not use with Vitamin C (ascorbic acid) in the same routine. Patch test before first use.

Suitable For:

· Oily, acne-prone, or combination skin

· Dull or uneven skin tone

· Not recommended for very dry or sensitive skin without introducing gradually
